messages:
maya: FYI we're seeing reports of an OpenSSL BIO UAF (CVE-2026-32476) being exploited in the wild. quick triage please — do we ship any components with libcrypto/bio exposures?

arjun: confirming runtime images use openssl via musl builds for some internal agents. checking image list now.

liu: list of services that link against system OpenSSL: kms-agent, uploader, connector-worker. kms-agent is on a pinned base image (ubuntu 22.04).

nate: CVE notes: remote exploitability when processing BIO pairs in streaming reads; patch available in openssl-3.2.2. exploit PoC circulating on vulndb.

maya: high priority -> we need: 1) block inbound attempts to the affected endpoints if possible, 2) patch images with updated OpenSSL, 3) rotate any session keys if there's evidence of compromise.

oncall-robert: @katie can we add WAF rule to block bad user agents and aggressive POSTs to /v1/stream and /upload endpoints?

katie: yesss. pushing a quick modblock for suspicious user-agent patterns + rate-limit 429 for bursters. will push in 2m.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollback job queued: rollback kms-agent to previous container image tag kms-agent:v20260211-rc1 if new deploy fails.

arjun: quick grep to find linked binaries: docker run --rm my-image:tag sh -c "ldd /app/bin/connector | grep ssl || true". doing across images now.

liu: Found 3 images using system libssl: connector-worker:sha256:aa12, uploader:sha256:bb34, kms-agent:sha256:cc56. starting rebuilds with openssl-3.2.2.

nate: prioritize kms-agent and uploader. kms-agent touches KMS keys — rotate service keys after patch. also enable audit logging for KMS agent calls for last 48h.

maya: @samantha need legal/incident comms guidance if customer keys were touched. any embargo or notification windows?

samantha: if keys were used, we need to notify affected customers under contract + SOC team. start sifting audit logs; don't send external comms yet.

arjun: patch builds started. CI pipeline note: set OPENSSL_ALLOW_DEPREC=1 workaround for aarch64 compile quirk. will push artifacts to staging registry on success.

maya: checklist: [ ] WAF rules deployed, [ ] kms-agent patch released, [ ] uploader patch released, [ ] rotate keys (if needed), [ ] audit logs collected, [ ] comms draft. Mark status in incident doc.

katie: WAF rule live — blocking 10.12.33.0/24 and user-agent regexs. seeing reduction in probes. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: kms-agent:v20260302-patched deployed to staging (sha256:dd77). running smoke tests.

arjun: staging smoke green for kms-agent. prepping canary to prod with 10% traffic.

nate: started audit export: 48h of KMS calls, will upload to secure S3 bucket r-infra-incident-1800123456.

maya: good work. keep thread for coord. if any positive indicators of compromise show up, escalate to all-hands incident channel and start customer-notify flow.

arjun: rolling kms-agent patch to prod canary now.

liu: note: some legacy on-prem scripts may bundle old libssl — adding ticket to PS to contact customers with managed on-prem.

maya: final — maintain RBAC for any rotations, grant minimum perms to temporary keys, enable audit logging retention 90 days for affected services.

samantha: drafting customer comms template, will share in 30m for legal review.

maya: thanks all. update the incident doc with timestamps and actions.
